body:
Addressed: the conflict with `main`. No review exists on this PR. GitHub showed the PR as conflicting, so this round is a refresh only.

**Finding: the PR did not merge with `main`.**
- I merged upstream/main e80c70942 into the branch. It is a merge commit. There is no rebase and no force-push.
- One file had a conflict: `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`, test `moved_suites_live_in_their_owner_crate_and_not_in_app`.
- Main (#3188) and this branch each changed the owner rows and the source read to directory suites.
- The result keeps the post rows, the sim rows and the source read of main. It keeps the motion row of this branch (`contour2d`).
- The class is DELTA: one conflict resolved by hand, in test code. No other hand edit.

**Pin:** `gate_maps_tests::moved_suites_live_in_their_owner_crate_and_not_in_app`.
- With the motion row of main (`arcs`) the test is red: `arcs missing from crates/motion/tests`.
- With the merged row it is green.
- `motion_tests_fold_into_at_most_sixteen_binaries` stays green.

**Checks on the new head:**
- `cargo check --tests -p <pkg>`, one package at a time: `xtask`, `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-post`, `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-tools`, `camcraft-ui-kit`, `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-ui`. All compile.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 12 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 9 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` stops on `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` (`needless_bool`). That file is the same as on main. This PR does not change it.
- Motion test count: 2015 tests, 78 ignored. Main added one test to `chamfer_circular.rs`. The merge carried it to `edges_edm/chamfer_circular.rs`.

**Not exercised:**
- `example_catalog` and the batch tier. The branch changes no generator code.
- Main moved to 1cf7390dc during the gates. I did not merge it. GitHub reports that the new head merges cleanly with it.

Reviewer: egg pool job review-4425, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

## Verdict: clean (merge-ready)

This is the first review of this PR. The PR moves test files only. It changes no generator, post, simulation or geometry code, so the review is not SAFETY tier.

**Build:** local, in `.claude/worktrees/review-4425`. The trial merge of head `5673a882f` with upstream/main `3c7cbe860` is clean (no conflicts). HEAD^1 is the PR head.

## What I checked

- **Moves.** `git diff -M --name-status` shows 153 renames (most `R100`). The only new files are the ten suite roots and the decision record. Three xtask test files and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md` change.
- **Each moved file is in its suite.** The ten suite directories hold 163 `.rs` files: 153 modules and 10 `main.rs` roots. The `mod` lines of the roots are 153 modules, plus `common` three times and `fixtures` one time. No file is outside a suite, so no test is lost.
- **Test counts.** `#[test]` attributes under `crates/motion/tests`: 1225 on upstream/main and 1225 on the merge. `#[ignore` attributes: 56 and 56.
- **Line edits.** I read each non-rename hunk. They are as the body says: `mod common;` to `use crate::common;`, the shared `fixtures` module in the `adaptive2d` root, `../` prefixes on `#[path]` and `include_str!`, two regenerate commands, and two heavy-lane ignore reasons that now name `motion heavy: adaptive2d`.
- **Stale names.** I searched the tree for `camcraft-motion --test <old name>`, `motion:` keys in xtask and known-fail markers in motion. Only the three `SLOW_BINARIES` (still flat) and old `RECOMMENDED.md` history text name an old binary.
- **Gate plans.** `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` maps to the ten suites and the xtask unit tests (12 steps). `gate heavy --dry-run` maps to 8 `motion heavy:` suites. `gate light --dry-run` finds the three `_light` twins in `adaptive2d`.
- **Laws.** `Process change: yes` is in the body (xtask changes). `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` does not change. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #3189`. The commit subject is conventional. Each suite root has a provenance line. The decision record cites **New tests join a directory suite**, and upstream AGENTS.md has that rule. No UI, snapshot, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change.
- **Goldens moved:** none. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changes. `golden_undercut` and `vertical_arc_entry` read their goldens from the new place and pass.

## Tests run on the merge (debug, 12 threads)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --tests --no-run` | builds 15 motion test binaries |
| adaptive2d | 87 passed, 12 ignored |
| contour2d | 144 passed, 1 ignored |
| edges_edm | 51 passed |
| entry_links | 108 passed |
| finishing3d | 83 passed, 1 ignored |
| holes | 63 passed |
| machining2d | 196 passed |
| machining3d | 85 passed, 2 ignored |
| multiaxis | 101 passed, 3 ignored |
| turning | 145 passed |
| `cargo test -p xtask` | all binaries passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean on this main (the `unit_sweep.rs:67` stop in the body is gone) |

**Extra suites run:** none were owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no importer code. The moved fixture `contour_outside_floor/fixtures/sign_plate_3443.json` is read by `contour2d`, which passes.

**Heavy lanes:** not run again. The author ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on this head `5673a882f` against main `e80c70942` today: 9 steps, 0 failed (PR body and https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4425#issuecomment-7229498204). Main changed after `e80c70942` only in new `cl` and `geometry` modules. It does not change `crates/motion`, so that record stays valid.

## Mutations (pin `motion_tests_fold_into_at_most_sixteen_binaries`)

1. Two empty flat files `crates/motion/tests/zz_mut1.rs` and `zz_mut2.rs` added: red, `17 motion test binaries (at most 16)`. Removed: tree clean.
2. Slow binary `pivot5d.rs` moved into `multiaxis/`: red, `slow binary pivot5d missing`. Moved back: tree clean.

The author also gives the red/green proof for the conflict resolution in `gate_maps_tests.rs` (`arcs` red, `contour2d` green).

## Findings

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- Overlapping open PRs (#4379, #4316, #4173, #3103) must move their new flat files into a suite when they refresh. The body lists them. The pin catches a new flat file only when the count goes above 16, so a reviewer of those PRs must check it.
